title: PlanNextAction
description: What the agent decides to do this turn. Anthropic tool-use forcing on the synthetic plan_next_action tool — the planner cannot emit anything else. Tool and active_intent enums are constrained per-call to the active goal's allowed tools and the loaded intent registry.

next.description: WF-1 contract: every turn lands in this closed-set decision surface. 'confirm' means execute a tool; 'done' terminates the active intent.

tool.description: Name of the tool to dispatch. Constrained per-turn to the intersection of (active_intent.allowed_tools, active_platform.driver_pack).

args.description: Tool-specific arguments. Schema validated by the tool's own contract.

response.description: Free-text rationale or report content. Operational only — never re-fed into prompts.

active_intent.description: The intent the agent says it is currently pursuing. Plan-graph reachability guard rejects unreachable picks.

current_screen_signature.description: What the agent thinks it's looking at. Cross-checked with DetectScreen output.
